title: Keto Prosciutto Skewers with Egyptian Flair
description: A keto-friendly appetizer or snack that combines the flavors of Egypt and Italy. Prosciutto-wrapped skewers are easy to make and perfect for a quick bite.

ingredients.name: Skewers (bamboo or metal)
ingredients.notes: Soak bamboo skewers in water for 30 minutes before use

instructions: Cut prosciutto into strips and wrap around each skewer.
Thread vibrant peppers, juicy tomatoes, and a sprinkle of Egyptian spices onto each skewer.
Drizzle olive oil over the skewers and season with salt and black pepper.
Place skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until the prosciutto is crispy.
